function.name: EventQuery
function.description: Search for calendar events that match a given text query within a user's calendar. The search considers both the title and description of the events. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

search_string.description: The text to search for within the title and description of an event.

start_date.description: The start date for the range of events to search, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the range of events to search, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

include_recurring.description: A flag to indicate whether to include recurring events in the search.

function.name: reschedule_event
function.description: Reschedule an event by assigning it a new date or time based on the provided ISO-8601 datetime string. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

event_identifier.description: A unique identifier for the event, such as a UUID.

new_datetime.description: The new date and time to which the event is being rescheduled, in ISO-8601 format (e.g., 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ').

message.content:
I’d love to help you schedule your next gym session!  
Could you let me know:

1. When would you like to have the session (date & time)?  
2. How long will it last?  
3. Where will you be going?  

If you already have a gym event in your calendar that you’d like to move, just give me its ID or a brief description and I can reschedule it for you.

We need to ask for details: date, time, duration, location? Or maybe we can schedule it at a default time? The user didn't specify. We should ask clarifying questions: when would you like to schedule your next gym session? What time? Duration? Location? Also, do you want to set a recurring event? We can ask. Then we can use the reschedule_event function if we have an event ID. But we don't have an event ID. We might need to create a new event. There's no function for creating events. Only searching and rescheduling. So we cannot create a new event. We can only reschedule an existing event. So we need to find an existing event that matches "gym" or "gym session". Then we can reschedule it. But the user didn't mention an existing event. So we need to ask for clarification. Probably we should ask: Do you already have a gym event scheduled?
